example_1_en: Strain gauge signals are very small and noise-sensitive.
example_1_zh: 應變規訊號很小，且對雜訊敏感。
example_2_en: Strain gauge wiring must be separated from high-current cables.
example_2_zh: 應變規線路必須與大電流線纜分開。

example_1_en: Copper foil thickness has a major impact on total weight.
example_1_zh: 銅箔厚度對總重量有很大影響。
example_2_en: The busbar thickness options are 1 millimeter and 2 millimeters.
example_2_zh: 銅排厚度選項為 1 毫米與 2 毫米。

example_1_en: Copper density is used to convert volume into weight.
example_1_zh: 銅密度用來將體積換算成重量。
example_2_en: The report uses stainless-steel density for the screw and washer calculation.
example_2_zh: 報告使用不鏽鋼密度來計算螺絲與墊片重量。

example_1_en: The handbook helps determine bonding requirements applicable to specific hardware.
example_1_zh: 本手冊協助判定適用於特定硬體的 bonding 要求。
example_2_en: Program documents may include requirements for a specific project.
example_2_zh: 計畫文件可能包含特定專案的要求。

example_1_en: High-frequency current can disturb low-level sensor signals.
example_1_zh: 高頻電流可能干擾低電位感測器訊號。
example_2_en: Switching noise may disturb the Data Acquisition (DAQ) channels.
example_2_zh: 切換雜訊可能干擾 DAQ 通道。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Parasitic capacitance can couple actuator noise into a nearby sensor line.
example_1_zh: 寄生電容可能將致動器雜訊耦合到附近感測器線路。
example_2_en: A conductive reference surface helps control parasitic capacitance paths.
example_2_zh: 導電參考面有助於控制寄生電容路徑。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: External RF Electromagnetic Environment (EME) should be tailored to the launch and test environment.
example_1_zh: 外部 RF 電磁環境應依發射與測試環境裁剪。
example_2_en: The RF receiver must remain functional under the specified external RF Electromagnetic Environment (EME).
example_2_zh: RF 接收器必須在指定外部 RF 電磁環境下維持功能。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Planning
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: System-level Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) can fail even if each electronic box passes Military Standard 461 (MIL-STD-461).
example_1_zh: 即使每個電子盒都通過 MIL-STD-461，系統層級 EMC 仍可能失敗。
example_2_en: The consultant should review the system-level Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) risk after installation on the avionics ring.
example_2_zh: 顧問應審查航電環安裝後的系統層級 EMC 風險。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Planning
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Corrosion mitigation must be included in the design.
example_1_zh: 設計中必須包含腐蝕緩解措施。
example_2_en: The copper reference ring is one mitigation for RF coupling.
example_2_zh: 銅參考環是降低 RF 耦合的一項措施。

example_1_en: Use short and wide conductors to create a low-inductance path.
example_1_zh: 使用短而寬的導體建立低電感路徑。
example_2_en: A low-inductance path is more important than DC resistance at high frequency.
example_2_zh: 在高頻時，低電感路徑比 DC 電阻更重要。

example_1_en: The reference ring should provide a low-impedance path.
example_1_zh: 參考環應提供低阻抗路徑。
example_2_en: A low-impedance connection is essential for RF return current.
example_2_zh: 低阻抗連接對 RF 回流電流很重要。

example_1_en: The bonding network should have uniform low impedance.
example_1_zh: 搭接網路應具有均勻的低阻抗。
example_2_en: A uniform reference helps reduce unexpected current paths.
example_2_zh: 一致的參考面有助於降低非預期電流路徑。

example_1_en: The path should survive the specified overload current.
example_1_zh: 該路徑應能承受規定的過載電流。
example_2_en: Overload current may heat a narrow conductor quickly.
example_2_zh: 過載電流可能快速加熱狹窄導體。

example_1_en: The shield should terminate to the local chassis.
example_1_zh: 屏蔽層應端接到局部機殼。
example_2_en: Local chassis bonding reduces cable shield current loops.
example_2_zh: 局部機殼搭接可降低電纜屏蔽層電流迴路。

example_1_en: The chassis reference should be defined before cable routing.
example_1_zh: 在電纜佈線前應先定義機殼參考點。
example_2_en: A stable chassis reference improves Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) repeatability.
example_2_zh: 穩定的機殼參考可改善 EMI 測試重複性。

chinese_meaning: 專用回流線；專用回流路徑
example_1_en: The 28 V supply should use a dedicated return conductor.
example_1_zh: 28 V 電源應使用專用回流導體。
example_2_en: A dedicated return keeps load current out of the reference ring.
example_2_zh: 專用回流可避免負載電流流入參考環。

example_1_en: Each joint should be inspected and measured.
example_1_zh: 每個接合點都應檢查與量測。
example_2_en: A loose joint can increase resistance and noise.
example_2_zh: 鬆動的接合點會增加電阻與雜訊。

example_1_en: Each structural element should be part of the controlled reference network.
example_1_zh: 每個結構元件都應納入受控參考網路。
example_2_en: An isolated structural element may become a noise source.
example_2_zh: 孤立的結構元件可能變成雜訊源。

example_1_en: Lightning indirect effects can couple into long cables.
example_1_zh: 雷擊間接效應可能耦合到長電纜中。
example_2_en: Reference rings help control some lightning indirect effects, but they are not enough alone.
example_2_zh: 參考環有助於控制部分雷擊間接效應，但單靠它們並不足夠。

example_1_en: DC resistance alone does not prove good RF performance.
example_1_zh: 僅有直流電阻無法證明良好的 RF 性能。
example_2_en: Use a four-wire meter for low DC resistance measurements.
example_2_zh: 使用四線式電表量測低直流電阻。

example_1_en: The metal layer should be continuous around the ring.
example_1_zh: 金屬層應沿著環形結構連續一圈。
example_2_en: A continuous path is better than several isolated metal strips.
example_2_zh: 連續路徑比數段孤立金屬條更好。

example_1_en: The conductive coating must not be left floating.
example_1_zh: 導電塗層不能處於浮接狀態。
example_2_en: Conductive coating can help control static charge on a composite surface.
example_2_zh: 導電塗層可協助控制複材表面的靜電荷。

example_1_en: Measure the end-to-end resistance from the A1 ring to the A4 ring.
example_1_zh: 量測 A1 參考環到 A4 參考環的端到端電阻。
example_2_en: End-to-end resistance is different from single-joint resistance.
example_2_zh: 端到端電阻不同於單一接合點電阻。

example_1_en: A verification matrix maps each bonding path to a test method.
example_1_zh: 驗證矩陣會將每條接合路徑對應到測試方法。
example_2_en: The avionics ring should have its own verification matrix.
example_2_zh: 航電環應建立自己的驗證矩陣。

example_1_en: Surface contamination increases bonding resistance.
example_1_zh: 表面污染會增加搭接電阻。
example_2_en: Inspection should identify contamination before assembly.
example_2_zh: 檢查應在組裝前找出污染物。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Please refer to the Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) test report for the measured limits.
example_1_zh: 請參考 EMC 測試報告中的量測限制。
example_2_en: The response should refer to the latest grounding diagram.
example_2_zh: 回覆內容應參照最新的接地圖。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Flight control and navigation are mission-critical functions.
example_1_zh: 飛控與導航是任務關鍵功能。
example_2_en: Mission-critical data should be monitored during all Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) test scenarios.
example_2_zh: 所有 EMC 測試情境都應監測任務關鍵資料。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

chinese_meaning: RF 發射禁止；發射抑制
example_1_en: RF transmit inhibit may be required during sensitive ground operations.
example_1_zh: 敏感地面操作期間可能需要 RF 發射禁止。
example_2_en: The test procedure should verify the RF transmit inhibit function.
example_2_zh: 測試程序應驗證 RF 發射禁止功能。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) protection is required near high-power transmitters.
example_1_zh: 在高功率發射機附近需要 GNSS 保護。
example_2_en: Protection measures should be verified during integration testing.
example_2_zh: 保護措施應在整合測試期間驗證。

example_1_en: ESD control is required during integration.
example_1_zh: 整合期間需要靜電控制。
example_2_en: ESD control includes grounding straps, mats, and handling procedures.
example_2_zh: ESD 控制包含接地腕帶、靜電墊與操作程序。

example_1_en: Good documentation helps future troubleshooting.
example_1_zh: 良好的文件化有助於未來排查問題。
example_2_en: Documentation should include design assumptions and test evidence.
example_2_zh: 文件資料應包含設計假設與測試證據。

example_1_en: A matrix is useful for tracking requirement compliance.
example_1_zh: 矩陣很適合用來追蹤需求符合性。
example_2_en: The review matrix shows open issues and responsible owners.
example_2_zh: 審查矩陣顯示未解問題與負責人。

example_1_en: Each bonding measurement should be stored as an acceptance record.
example_1_zh: 每項搭接量測都應保存為驗收紀錄。
example_2_en: The consultant may ask for the acceptance record before Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing.
example_2_zh: 顧問可能會在 EMC 測試前要求查看驗收紀錄。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Packet loss must be monitored during RF and actuator tests.
example_1_zh: RF 與致動器測試期間必須監測封包遺失。
example_2_en: A sudden increase in packet loss may indicate Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) susceptibility.
example_2_zh: 封包遺失突然增加可能表示 EMC 易受擾。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

chinese_meaning: 中央集線座；中央搭接匯集點
example_1_en: The central hub provides a low-impedance connection between the three panels.
example_1_zh: 中央 hub 提供三片板之間的低阻抗連接。
example_2_en: Sensitive electronics should not be mounted directly on the central hub.
example_2_zh: 敏感電子設備不應直接安裝在中央 hub 上。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: The reference ring provides a continuous path around the avionics ring.
example_1_zh: 參考環在航電環周圍提供連續路徑。
example_2_en: Each panel should connect to the reference ring at multiple points.
example_2_zh: 每片板都應以多點連接到參考環。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Precipitation static can accumulate on non-conductive surfaces.
example_1_zh: 降水靜電可能累積在不導電表面上。
example_2_en: The avionics ring needs a controlled discharge path for precipitation static.
example_2_zh: 航電環需要為降水靜電提供可控洩放路徑。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Common-mode current on a cable can increase radiated emissions.
example_1_zh: 線纜上的共模電流可能增加輻射發射。
example_2_en: Shield termination and filtering are used to control common-mode current.
example_2_zh: 屏蔽終端與濾波可用來控制共模電流。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: We need practical implementation guidance, not only theoretical Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) advice.
example_1_zh: 我們需要實際執行的指導，而不只是理論上的 EMC 建議。
example_2_en: The consultant should recommend practical implementation methods for composite structures.
example_2_zh: 顧問應建議適用於複合材質結構的實作方式。

example_1_en: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) constraints must be checked during countdown.
example_1_zh: 倒數期間必須確認 EMC 限制。
example_2_en: Some transmitters may be disabled during the countdown.
example_2_zh: 某些發射機可能在倒數期間停用。

example_1_en: The test report records results and anomalies.
example_1_zh: 測試報告記錄結果與異常。
example_2_en: The test report should include photos, setup diagrams, and raw data.
example_2_zh: 測試報告應包含照片、架設圖與原始數據。

example_1_en: The switching converter was identified as the noise source.
example_1_zh: 切換式轉換器被確認為雜訊源。
example_2_en: Finding the noise source is the first step in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) troubleshooting.
example_2_zh: 找出雜訊源是 EMC 故障排查的第一步。

example_1_en: Converter noise is a common problem in power systems.
example_1_zh: 轉換器雜訊是電源系統中的常見問題。
example_2_en: A common problem during integration is incomplete shield termination.
example_2_zh: 整合期間常見問題是不完整的屏蔽端接。

example_1_en: The measurement procedure defines equipment setup and limits.
example_1_zh: 量測程序定義設備架設與限制值。
example_2_en: A repeatable measurement procedure improves test credibility.
example_2_zh: 可重複的量測程序可提升測試可信度。

example_1_en: Test planning should start before hardware integration.
example_1_zh: 測試規劃應在硬體整合前開始。
example_2_en: Good test planning reduces schedule risk during Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) qualification.
example_2_zh: 良好的測試規劃可降低 EMC 鑑定期間的時程風險。

example_1_en: Integration-stage verification confirms system-level Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) behavior.
example_1_zh: 整合階段驗證確認系統級 EMC 行為。
example_2_en: Integration-stage verification should be planned before final assembly.
example_2_zh: 整合階段驗證應在最終組裝前規劃。

example_1_en: Antenna coupling can disturb nearby receivers.
example_1_zh: 天線耦合可能干擾附近接收器。
example_2_en: Antenna coupling depends on distance, frequency, and orientation.
example_2_zh: 天線耦合取決於距離、頻率與方向。

chinese_meaning: 電源調查 / 電源量測
example_1_en: A power survey checks voltage ripple and transients.
example_1_zh: 電源調查會檢查電壓漣波與暫態。
example_2_en: The power survey should be repeated after major harness changes.
example_2_zh: 重大線束變更後應重複執行電源調查。

example_1_en: Power quality affects both reliability and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) performance.
example_1_zh: 電源品質會影響可靠度與 EMC 表現。
example_2_en: Power quality should be checked under maximum load conditions.
example_2_zh: 電源品質應在最大負載條件下檢查。

example_1_en: The cable shield must be terminated correctly.
example_1_zh: 線纜屏蔽層必須正確端接。
example_2_en: A damaged shield can reduce cable immunity.
example_2_zh: 受損的屏蔽層可能降低線纜抗擾能力。

example_1_en: A compliance matrix tracks every Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) requirement.
example_1_zh: 符合性矩陣追蹤每項 EMC 需求。
example_2_en: The compliance matrix should identify verification status and evidence.
example_2_zh: 符合性矩陣應標示驗證狀態與證據。

example_1_en: Range requirements may add extra safety constraints.
example_1_zh: 發射場要求可能增加額外安全限制。
example_2_en: Range requirements can affect RF operations during countdown.
example_2_zh: 發射場要求可能影響倒數期間的 RF 操作。

example_1_en: Filter integration must consider grounding and layout.
example_1_zh: 濾波器整合必須考慮接地與佈局。
example_2_en: Bad filter integration may reduce attenuation at high frequency.
example_2_zh: 不良濾波器整合可能降低高頻衰減效果。

example_1_en: The bonding requirement defines the maximum resistance.
example_1_zh: 搭接要求定義最大電阻值。
example_2_en: Each bonding requirement should include an inspection method.
example_2_zh: 每項搭接要求都應包含檢查方法。

example_1_en: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) problems often appear during the integration stage.
example_1_zh: EMC 問題常在整合階段出現。
example_2_en: Integration-stage verification should include bonding and power checks.
example_2_zh: 整合階段驗證應包含搭接與電源檢查。

example_1_en: The table of contents lists all major Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) topics.
example_1_zh: 目錄列出所有主要 EMC 主題。
example_2_en: A clear table of contents helps reviewers find each section quickly.
example_2_zh: 清楚的目錄可幫助審查者快速找到各章節。

example_1_en: The test procedure should describe how to measure bonding resistance.
example_1_zh: 測試程序應描述如何量測搭接電阻。
example_2_en: A clear test procedure reduces ambiguity during integration.
example_2_zh: 清楚的測試程序可降低整合時的模糊性。

example_1_en: Resistance measurement is required for bonding verification.
example_1_zh: 搭接驗證需要電阻量測。
example_2_en: Measurement points should be defined in the test procedure.
example_2_zh: 量測點應在測試程序中定義。

example_1_en: Ground loops are a common Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) failure mode.
example_1_zh: 地迴路是常見的 EMC 失效模式。
example_2_en: We should ask the consultant about common integration failure modes.
example_2_zh: 我們應詢問顧問常見的整合失效模式。

example_1_en: We need a test plan for system-level Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) verification.
example_1_zh: 我們需要系統級 EMC 驗證測試計畫。
example_2_en: The test plan should include bonding checks and RF self-compatibility tests.
example_2_zh: 測試計畫應包含搭接檢查與 RF 自相容測試。

chinese_meaning: EMC 測試室；電磁相容性測試室
example_1_en: The integrated avionics system should be tested in an Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) chamber.
example_1_zh: 整合後的航電系統應在 EMC 測試艙中測試。
example_2_en: Chamber testing helps reveal radiated emission problems.
example_2_zh: Chamber 測試有助於發現輻射發射問題。

example_1_en: Sensor return should be separated from noisy power return.
example_1_zh: 感測器回流應與高雜訊電源回流分開。
example_2_en: Uncontrolled sensor return may create measurement error.
example_2_zh: 未受控的感測器回流可能造成量測誤差。

example_1_en: A metal chassis often acts as an RF reference.
example_1_zh: 金屬機殼通常可作為射頻參考。
example_2_en: We need to create an RF reference inside the composite structure.
example_2_zh: 我們需要在複材結構內建立射頻參考。

example_1_en: RF compatibility is critical for communication modules.
example_1_zh: RF 相容性對通訊模組非常關鍵。
example_2_en: We need to verify RF compatibility between S-band, UHF, and C-band systems.
example_2_zh: 我們需要驗證 S-band、UHF 與 C-band 系統之間的 RF 相容性。

example_1_en: The cable shield must not be left floating.
example_1_zh: 線纜屏蔽層不應懸空。
example_2_en: Cable shields should be terminated consistently across the system.
example_2_zh: 線纜屏蔽層應在系統中一致地端接。

example_1_en: Each connector should have a defined shield termination method.
example_1_zh: 每個連接器都應有明確的屏蔽端接方式。
example_2_en: Connector backshell bonding must be reviewed.
example_2_zh: 連接器後殼搭接必須審查。

example_1_en: A copper bar can serve as a low-impedance bonding bus.
example_1_zh: 銅排可以作為低阻抗搭接匯流排。
example_2_en: Subsystem enclosures can be bonded to the copper bar.
example_2_zh: 子系統外殼可以搭接到銅排。

example_1_en: Copper foil can create a local shielding surface.
example_1_zh: 銅箔可以建立局部屏蔽面。
example_2_en: Copper foil must be bonded to the main grounding network.
example_2_zh: 銅箔必須搭接到主接地網路。

example_1_en: The subsystems are mounted on vertical composite mounting panels.
example_1_zh: 子系統安裝在垂直複合材質安裝板上。
example_2_en: Each mounting panel may need a local ground plane.
example_2_zh: 每片安裝板可能需要局部接地平面。

example_1_en: The avionics ring is made of non-conductive composite material.

example_1_en: Multi-point bonding is often preferred for high-frequency Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) control.
example_1_zh: 高頻 EMC 控制通常偏好多點搭接。
example_2_en: The rings may require multi-point bonding around the circumference.
example_2_zh: 航電環可能需要沿圓周做多點搭接。

example_1_en: Power return may be connected to chassis at a controlled point.
example_1_zh: 電源回流可能需要在受控點連接到機殼地。
example_2_en: A controlled point helps manage return current flow.
example_2_zh: 受控連接點有助於管理回流電流。

example_1_en: Bonding straps should provide a low-impedance path.
example_1_zh: 搭接編織帶應提供低阻抗路徑。
example_2_en: A long wire is not a low-impedance path at high frequency.
example_2_zh: 長導線在高頻下不是低阻抗路徑。

example_1_en: High-frequency current follows the lowest impedance return path.
example_1_zh: 高頻電流會沿著最低阻抗回流路徑流動。
example_2_en: An uncontrolled return path may cause Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) problems.
example_2_zh: 未受控的回流路徑可能造成 EMC 問題。

example_1_en: A ground plane can provide a local return path.
example_1_zh: 接地平面可提供局部回流路徑。
example_2_en: We may need to add a metallic ground plane to each composite panel.
example_2_zh: 我們可能需要在每片複合板上增加金屬接地平面。

example_1_en: The system needs a stable ground reference.
example_1_zh: 系統需要穩定的接地參考。
example_2_en: Cable shields must be terminated to a proper ground reference.
example_2_zh: 線纜屏蔽層必須端接到適當的地參考。

example_1_en: Shielding reduces radiated emissions and susceptibility.
example_1_zh: 屏蔽可降低輻射發射與敏感度。
example_2_en: The composite ring does not naturally provide shielding.
example_2_zh: 複合材質航電環本身不會自然提供屏蔽。

example_1_en: Bonding provides a low-impedance path between metal parts.
example_1_zh: 搭接提供金屬部件之間的低阻抗路徑。
example_2_en: Each enclosure should have a defined bonding path.
example_2_zh: 每個外殼都應有明確的搭接路徑。

example_1_en: Grounding is difficult when the structure is non-conductive.
example_1_zh: 當結構不導電時，接地會變得困難。
example_2_en: We need a clear grounding strategy for the avionics rings.
example_2_zh: 我們需要明確的航電環接地策略。

example_1_en: MIL-STD-464 focuses on system-level Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) requirements.
example_1_zh: MIL-STD-464 著重於系統級 E3 要求。
example_2_en: We need to control Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) risks before vehicle integration.
example_2_zh: 我們需要在載具整合前控制 E3 風險。

example_1_en: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) problems often appear during system integration.
example_1_zh: EMC 問題常在系統整合階段出現。
example_2_en: The avionics ring must be designed with Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) in mind.
example_2_zh: 航電環設計時必須考慮 EMC。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Core Terms

example_1_en: Capacitive coupling may introduce noise into the receiver input.
example_1_zh: 電容耦合可能把雜訊導入接收器輸入端。
example_2_en: Reducing cable coupling is important for aircraft Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) design.
example_2_zh: 降低電纜耦合對飛機 EMC 設計很重要。

example_1_en: Conducted emission can travel through power lines.
example_1_zh: 傳導發射可透過電源線傳播。
example_2_en: Power filters help reduce conducted emission.
example_2_zh: 電源濾波器有助於降低傳導發射。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Core Terms

example_1_en: Radiated emission may increase after harness integration.
example_1_zh: 線束整合後，輻射發射可能增加。
example_2_en: The avionics assembly should be checked for radiated emission issues.
example_2_zh: 航電組件應檢查輻射發射問題。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Core Terms

example_1_en: The designer must incorporate mechanical and thermal requirements.
example_1_zh: 設計師必須納入機械與熱要求。
example_2_en: The panel design should incorporate dedicated bonding points.
example_2_zh: 板件設計應納入專用 bonding 點。

example_1_en: The final design may require a compromise between weight and Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) margin.
example_1_zh: 最終設計可能需要在重量和 EMC 裕度之間取捨。
example_2_en: Avoid a compromise that weakens the fault-current path.
example_2_zh: 避免做出會削弱故障電流路徑的妥協。

example_1_en: This is particularly important around fuel and pyrotechnics.
example_1_zh: 這在燃料與火工品周圍特別重要。
example_2_en: Class R bonding is particularly sensitive to strap length.
example_2_zh: Class R bonding 對 strap 長度特別敏感。

example_1_en: The design should keep enough electrical and thermal margin.
example_1_zh: 設計應保留足夠的電氣與熱裕度。
example_2_en: A poor bonding path can reduce Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) margin.
example_2_zh: 不良接合路徑可能降低 EMC 裕度。

example_1_en: A drawing note should specify cleaning and resistance requirements.
example_1_zh: 圖面註記應指定清潔與電阻要求。
example_2_en: Use a local drawing note for a special bonding location.
example_2_zh: 對特殊接合位置使用局部圖面註記。

example_1_en: Fault protection prevents overheating during a short circuit.
example_1_zh: 故障保護可避免短路時過熱。
example_2_en: Bonding for fault protection is different from RF bonding.
example_2_zh: 故障保護用搭接與 RF 搭接不同。

example_1_en: The system requirement must be traceable to the mission objective.
example_1_zh: 系統需求必須能追溯到任務目標。
example_2_en: A clear system requirement prevents different teams from using different assumptions.
example_2_zh: 清楚的系統需求可避免不同團隊使用不同假設。

example_1_en: Each measurement result should be traceable to a specific joint.
example_1_zh: 每個量測結果都應可追溯到特定接點。
example_2_en: Requirements should be traceable from system level to design drawings.
example_2_zh: 要求應可從系統層級追溯到設計圖面。

example_1_en: A flag note can be reused at multiple drawing locations.
example_1_zh: 旗標註記可重複用於圖面多個位置。
example_2_en: The flag note identifies surfaces that require preparation.
example_2_zh: 旗標註記可標示需要表面準備的位置。

example_1_en: A local note applies only to a specific location.
example_1_zh: 局部註記只適用於特定位置。
example_2_en: Use a local note when one joint has a different resistance limit.
example_2_zh: 當某個接點有不同電阻限制時，使用局部註記。

example_1_en: A general note applies to the entire drawing.
example_1_zh: 一般註記適用於整張圖面。
example_2_en: The general note can define the default cleaning requirement.
example_2_zh: 一般註記可定義預設清潔要求。

example_1_en: Quality records should include bonding resistance measurements.
example_1_zh: 品質紀錄應包含接合電阻量測值。
example_2_en: The quality record supports final acceptance.
example_2_zh: 品質紀錄可支援最終驗收。

example_1_en: A floating shield may act like a long antenna instead of a shield.
example_1_zh: 浮接屏蔽層可能像長天線，而不是屏蔽。
example_2_en: The design must prevent the cable shield from becoming a floating shield.
example_2_zh: 設計必須避免線纜屏蔽層變成浮接屏蔽層。

example_1_en: A floating enclosure may develop a different potential from nearby equipment.

example_2_en: Floating enclosures can make the Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) result sensitive to cable placement.
example_2_zh: 浮接機殼會讓 EMC 結果容易受到線束擺放影響。

example_1_en: A long cable shield can become a coupling path for RF noise.
example_1_zh: 長距離線纜屏蔽層可能變成 RF 雜訊的耦合路徑。
example_2_en: The review should identify every major coupling path between noisy and sensitive subsystems.
example_2_zh: 審查應識別強干擾與敏感子系統之間的主要耦合路徑。

example_2_en: A victim should be monitored during each worst-case Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) test.
example_2_zh: 每個最壞情境 EMC 測試都應監測受害設備。

example_1_en: A verification record should show the measured value and the acceptance limit.
example_1_zh: 驗證紀錄應顯示量測值與允收限制。
example_2_en: The verification record supports the final MIL-STD-464 compliance review.
example_2_zh: 驗證紀錄支援最終 MIL-STD-464 符合性審查。

example_2_en: Lightning, ESD, RF exposure, and intra-system Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) are part of Electromagnetic Environmental Effects.

example_1_en: Small gaps can become leakage paths for RF energy.

example_2_en: We should minimize gaps in the shielding structure.
example_2_zh: 我們應盡量減少屏蔽結構中的縫隙。

example_1_en: Gaps and seams can reduce shielding effectiveness.

example_2_en: Each seam should be bonded or overlapped properly.

example_1_zh: 接收器必須避免受到強發射機影響。
example_2_en: A receiver can lose sensitivity in a high RF environment.
example_2_zh: 接收器在高 RF 環境中可能失去靈敏度。

example_1_en: Firing circuit isolation prevents unintended current paths.
example_1_zh: 點火電路隔離可避免非預期電流路徑。
example_2_en: Isolation is required between safety-critical and noisy circuits.
example_2_zh: 安全關鍵電路與噪聲電路之間需要隔離。

example_1_en: The 28 V bus supplies power to avionics equipment.
example_1_zh: 28V 匯流排供電給航電設備。
example_2_en: A noisy power bus can affect multiple subsystems.
example_2_zh: 有雜訊的電源母線可能影響多個子系統。

example_1_en: Please refer to the attached briefing document for more details.

example_1_en: Qualification testing confirms compliance with requirements.
example_1_zh: 資格測試確認是否符合規範要求。
example_2_en: We should reduce integration risks before qualification testing.
example_2_zh: 我們應在資格測試前降低整合風險。

example_1_en: We need a verification plan for the bonding network.
example_1_zh: 我們需要一份搭接網路驗證計畫。
example_2_en: Verification should be performed before formal qualification.
example_2_zh: 驗證應在正式資格測試前執行。

example_1_en: Valve controllers and jet vane drivers are high-current loads.
example_1_zh: 閥門控制器與 JetVane 驅動器屬於大電流負載。
example_2_en: High-current loads should not share uncontrolled return paths with sensors.
example_2_zh: 大電流負載不應與感測器共用未受控回流路徑。

example_1_en: Metal-to-metal contact is preferred for RF performance.
example_1_zh: 金屬對金屬接觸對 RF 性能較佳。
example_2_en: A gasket may be needed when metal-to-metal contact is not reliable.
example_2_zh: 當金屬對金屬接觸不可靠時，可能需要墊片。

example_1_en: Box-level tests are performed before integration.
example_1_zh: 設備級測試會在整合前執行。
example_2_en: Box-level compliance does not guarantee vehicle-level compatibility.
example_2_zh: 設備級符合性不保證載具級相容性。

example_1_en: Vehicle-level Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing verifies the complete system.
example_1_zh: 載具級 Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) 測試驗證完整系統。
example_2_en: Vehicle-level limits are usually stricter than informal bench checks.
example_2_zh: 載具級限制通常比非正式桌上測試更嚴格。

example_1_en: Vehicle-level requirements are flowed down to each box.
example_1_zh: 載具級需求會下展到每個設備盒。
example_2_en: Requirement flow-down prevents gaps between system and subsystem design.
example_2_zh: 需求下展可避免系統與子系統設計之間產生落差。

example_1_en: A dedicated current return path is preferred for power circuits.
example_1_zh: 電源電路最好使用專用的電流回流路徑。
example_2_en: Do not rely on the composite panel as the current return path.
example_2_zh: 不要依賴複材板作為電流回流路徑。

example_1_en: A jumper may be used when direct contact is impractical.
example_1_zh: 當直接接觸不可行時，可使用跳接線。
example_2_en: The jumper should be short, wide, and easy to inspect.
example_2_zh: 跳接線應該短、寬且容易檢查。

example_1_en: RF impedance is more important than DC resistance for high-frequency bonding.
example_1_zh: 對高頻接合而言，RF 阻抗比直流電阻更重要。
example_2_en: The reference ring should minimize RF impedance.
example_2_zh: 參考環應盡量降低 RF 阻抗。

example_1_en: A micro-ohmmeter is used to measure very low bonding resistance.
example_1_zh: 微歐姆計用於量測很低的接合電阻。
example_2_en: Use a four-wire method with the micro-ohmmeter.
example_2_zh: 使用微歐姆計時應採用四線式量測。

example_1_en: DC resistance is easy to measure with a micro-ohmmeter.
example_1_zh: 直流電阻可用微歐姆計量測。
example_2_en: Low resistance does not always mean good RF performance.
example_2_zh: 低電阻不一定代表良好的 RF 性能。

example_1_en: Capacitance between structures can affect RF impedance.
example_1_zh: 結構之間的電容會影響 RF 阻抗。
example_2_en: The jumper and nearby metal can form unwanted capacitance.
example_2_zh: 跳接線與附近金屬可能形成非預期電容。

example_1_en: Inductance increases the impedance at high frequency.
example_1_zh: 電感會提高高頻下的阻抗。
example_2_en: Reducing loop area helps reduce inductance.
example_2_zh: 減少迴路面積有助於降低電感。

example_1_en: Reactance changes with frequency.
example_1_zh: 電抗會隨頻率改變。
example_2_en: Impedance includes resistance and reactance.
example_2_zh: 阻抗包含電阻與電抗。

example_1_en: A short circuit to the chassis can create a shock hazard.
example_1_zh: 短路到機殼可能造成觸電危害。
example_2_en: The design should prevent a short circuit from entering the composite structure.
example_2_zh: 設計應避免短路電流進入複材結構。

example_1_en: We would like to consult with an experienced aerospace Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) consultant.
example_1_zh: 我們想請教一位有航太 Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) 經驗的顧問。
example_2_en: The consultant should review our grounding and shielding concept.
example_2_zh: 顧問應該審查我們的接地與屏蔽概念。

example_1_en: Worst-case simultaneous operation should include RF transmit and actuator motion.
example_1_zh: 最壞情境同時操作應包含 RF 發射與致動器動作。
example_2_en: The system must not lose critical data during worst-case simultaneous operation.
example_2_zh: 系統在最壞情境同時操作時不得遺失關鍵資料。

example_2_en: Keep the strap as short as possible.
example_2_zh: 盡可能縮短帶材長度。

example_2_zh: 發射場 RF 發射機是一種可能的外部來源。

example_2_en: We need to verify the effectiveness of the bonding network.
example_2_zh: 我們需要驗證搭接網路的有效性。

example_1_en: Although each subsystem passed Military Standard 461 (MIL-STD-461), system-level integration still needs to be verified.
example_1_zh: 雖然每個子系統都通過 MIL-STD-461，系統級整合仍然需要驗證。
example_2_en: Although the ring is lightweight, it does not provide a natural conductive reference.
example_2_zh: 雖然航電環很輕，但它不會提供天然的導電參考。

example_1_en: The A1 avionics ring is approximately 110 cm in diameter.
example_1_zh: A1 航電環直徑約 110 公分。
example_2_en: Each composite panel is approximately 50 cm by 40 cm.
example_2_zh: 每片複合板尺寸約為 50 公分乘 40 公分。

example_1_en: The structure may not provide a sufficient Radio Frequency (RF) reference.
example_1_zh: 此結構可能無法提供足夠的 RF 參考。
example_2_en: We need sufficient bonding points around the avionics ring.
example_2_zh: 我們需要在航電環周圍提供足夠的搭接點。

example_1_en: Wire segregation prevents noisy cables from coupling into sensitive signals.
example_1_zh: 線路隔離可避免噪聲線纜耦合到敏感訊號。
example_2_en: Power, RF, and low-level analog wires need proper wire segregation.
example_2_zh: 電源、RF 與低位準類比線路需要適當線路隔離。

example_1_en: Susceptibility tests evaluate how equipment reacts to external fields.
example_1_zh: 敏感度測試評估設備對外部場的反應。
example_2_en: Poor shielding increases system susceptibility.
example_2_zh: 屏蔽不良會增加系統敏感度。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Core Terms

example_1_en: Edge lifting of copper foil should be avoided during installation.
example_1_zh: 施工時應避免銅箔邊緣翹起。
example_2_en: Edge lifting can create unreliable electrical contact.
example_2_zh: 邊緣翹起可能造成不可靠的電氣接觸。

example_1_en: Surface treatment must not insulate the bonding contact area.
example_1_zh: 表面處理不可使搭接接觸面變成絕緣。
example_2_en: Copper, aluminum, and stainless steel may require different surface treatments.
example_2_zh: 銅、鋁與不鏽鋼可能需要不同的表面處理。

example_1_en: Adhesive weight is outside the current estimate boundary.
example_1_zh: 黏著劑重量不在目前估算邊界內。
example_2_en: The adhesive process must prevent copper foil edges from lifting.
example_2_zh: 黏著製程必須避免銅箔邊緣翹起。

example_1_en: The weight estimate includes copper foil, busbars, screws, washers, and braided straps.
example_1_zh: 重量估算包含銅箔、銅排、螺絲、墊片與編織帶。
example_2_en: This weight estimate does not include adhesive or installation loss.
example_2_zh: 此重量估算不包含黏著劑或施工耗損。

example_1_en: The upper ring busbar length is based on the ring circumference.
example_1_zh: 上方環形銅排長度依據環體圓周長計算。
example_2_en: The circumference is calculated from the ring diameter.
example_2_zh: 圓周長由環體直徑計算。

example_1_en: The final flight article should use the 100 micrometer copper foil baseline.
example_1_zh: 最終飛行件應以 100 微米銅箔為基準。
example_2_en: Prototype weights may differ from the flight article weight.
example_2_zh: 原型件重量可能與飛行件重量不同。

example_1_en: We have identified aerospace-grade materials for the outer surface.
example_1_zh: 我們已找到可用於外表面的航太等級材料。
example_2_en: Aerospace-grade coatings are usually qualified for harsh environments.
example_2_zh: 航太等級塗層通常會通過嚴苛環境的驗證。

chinese_meaning: 待最終確認；需最終確認
example_1_en: The values are preliminary assumptions and subject to final confirmation.
example_1_zh: 這些數值為初步假設，仍待最終確認。
example_2_en: The bonding method is subject to final confirmation by the structural team.
example_2_zh: 搭接方法仍需由結構團隊做最終確認。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: The acceptance criteria should define allowable functional degradation.
example_1_zh: 驗收標準應定義允許的功能劣化程度。
example_2_en: Mission-critical functions should have no functional degradation during Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) testing.
example_2_zh: 任務關鍵功能在 EMC 測試期間不應有功能劣化。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

chinese_meaning: 多點縫合式連接；密集搭接點
example_1_en: More stitching points reduce the high-frequency impedance of the panel edge.
example_1_zh: 更多 stitching 點可降低板邊高頻阻抗。
example_2_en: RF-sensitive areas should use a shorter stitching interval.
example_2_zh: RF 敏感區應使用較短的 stitching 間距。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: The values shown in this table are preliminary assumptions.
example_1_zh: 此表中的數值為初步假設。
example_2_en: This grounding layout is based on a preliminary assumption.
example_2_zh: 此接地配置是基於初步假設。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: The structural department has preliminarily agreed to this approach.
example_1_zh: 結構部門已初步同意此作法。
example_2_en: The acceptance values were preliminarily defined for discussion.
example_2_zh: 驗收值是為了討論而初步定義的。
source_chapter: EMC顧問回覆與系統整合詞彙

example_1_en: Self-compatibility testing checks interference within the vehicle.
example_1_zh: 自相容性測試會檢查載具內部干擾。
example_2_en: Self-compatibility problems often appear when multiple radios operate together.
example_2_zh: 多個無線電同時運作時常會出現自相容性問題。

example_1_en: The braided strap is modeled as tinned copper in the weight estimate.
example_1_zh: 重量估算中將編織帶視為鍍錫銅。
example_2_en: Tinned copper can improve corrosion resistance compared with bare copper.
example_2_zh: 相較於裸銅，鍍錫銅可提升耐腐蝕性。

example_1_en: Bonding inspection should be performed after installation.
example_1_zh: 安裝後應執行搭接檢查。
example_2_en: Visual inspection alone is not sufficient for bonding verification.
example_2_zh: 僅靠目視檢查不足以驗證搭接。

example_1_en: The consultant should help define acceptance criteria.
example_1_zh: 顧問應協助定義驗收標準。
example_2_en: Bonding resistance limits should be part of the acceptance criteria.
example_2_zh: 搭接電阻限制應納入驗收標準。

example_1_en: The coax shield should be bonded at the antenna interface.
example_1_zh: 同軸線屏蔽層應在天線介面搭接。
example_2_en: Poor coax shield bonding may cause RF leakage.
example_2_zh: 同軸屏蔽搭接不良可能造成 RF 洩漏。

example_1_en: The avionics ring does not have a conductive chassis.
example_1_zh: 航電環沒有導電機殼。
example_2_en: Without a conductive chassis, shield termination becomes more difficult.
example_2_zh: 沒有導電機殼時，屏蔽端接會變得更困難。

example_1_en: Each subsystem enclosure should be bonded to the reference network.
example_1_zh: 每個子系統外殼都應搭接到參考網路。
example_2_en: A floating enclosure may increase radiated emissions.
example_2_zh: 浮接外殼可能增加輻射發射。

example_1_en: Umbilical transients may occur during disconnect.
example_1_zh: 臍帶纜線在斷開時可能產生暫態。
example_2_en: The avionics power input must tolerate umbilical transients.
example_2_zh: 航電電源輸入必須能承受臍帶纜線暫態。

example_1_en: Military Standard 461 (MIL-STD-461) and MIL-STD-464 are applicable standards.
example_1_zh: Military Standard 461 (MIL-STD-461) 與 MIL-STD-464 是適用標準。
example_2_en: Applicable standards should be listed before test planning begins.
example_2_zh: 在測試規劃開始前應列出適用標準。

example_1_en: Our goal is to support MIL-STD-464 compliance.
example_1_zh: 我們的目標是支撐 MIL-STD-464 合規。
example_2_en: Box-level compliance does not guarantee system-level compliance.
example_2_zh: 單機合規不代表系統級一定合規。
category: Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) / Electromagnetic Environmental Effects (E3) Core Terms

example_1_en: The weight model is based on the ring geometry and copper coverage.
example_1_zh: 重量模型以環體幾何尺寸與銅箔覆蓋率為基礎。
example_2_en: Incorrect geometry will lead to an incorrect weight estimate.
example_2_zh: 幾何尺寸錯誤會導致重量估算錯誤。
